args: Analyze integer-overflow and bounds-check risks in `get_vlmeta_from_trailer` in `c-blosc2/blosc/frame.c`, especially all uses of `trailer_pos`, `offset`, `content_len`, and `trailer_len`. Recommend the narrowest root-cause patch for the reported overflow in `offset + 1 + 4 + content_len`, and note whether nearby checks need adjustment to make the fix robust.

The supplied ASan report shows attacker-controlled serialized `content_len = INT32_MAX` bypassing the signed comparison `trailer_len < offset + 1 + 4 + content_len` due to signed 32-bit overflow, followed by an oversized memcpy from `content_marker + 5`. The path is an in-memory attacker-controlled frame passed to `blosc2_schunk_from_buffer(..., copy=false)`, then `frame_get_vlmetalayers`, then this parser. I am inspecting lines 1372 onward and intend to use subtraction-based checks (first ensure five header bytes remain, then ensure content length is no greater than remaining bytes) rather than merely widening one expression. Please assess parser types and return/cleanup implications so intended valid VL metadata remains supported.
